now_the_spec_says: A gate issues a CLEARANCE as the tester issues a VALIDATION: one writer, append-only, address derived from the ticket id. Where a boat stands is DERIVED from its clearances, never written — the ticket's state string dies. A class declares a prerequisite graph, not an order.
